skills.title: Place value and total value
skills.scope: Place value and total value of digits up to tens of thousands; reading and writing numbers up to 10,000 in symbols.

skills.title: Read and write numbers in words
skills.scope: Read and write numbers up to 1,000 in words.

skills.title: Order and round numbers
skills.scope: Order numbers up to 1,000; round numbers up to 1,000 to the nearest ten.

skills.title: Factors and multiples
skills.scope: Factors of numbers up to 50; multiples of numbers up to 100.

skills.title: Even and odd numbers and patterns
skills.scope: Even and odd numbers up to 100; number patterns using even and odd numbers.

skills.title: Roman numerals up to X
skills.scope: Write Hindu-Arabic numerals as Roman numerals up to X.

skills.title: Addition with regrouping
skills.scope: Add up to two 4-digit numbers with single and double regrouping (sums up to 10,000); estimate sums by rounding to the nearest ten; addition patterns.

skills.title: Subtraction with regrouping
skills.scope: Subtract up to 4-digit numbers without and with regrouping; estimate differences by rounding to the nearest ten; subtraction patterns from up to 10,000.

skills.title: Multiply by multiples of 10
skills.scope: Multiply up to a two-digit number by multiples of 10.

skills.title: Multiply two-digit numbers
skills.scope: Multiply a two-digit number by a two-digit number with and without regrouping; estimate products (up to 1,000) by rounding to the nearest ten; multiplication patterns with products up to 100.

skills.title: Divide by a one-digit number
skills.scope: Divide up to a two-digit number by a one-digit number with and without remainder; relate multiplication and division.

skills.title: Represent fractions
skills.scope: Numerator and denominator; fractions with denominators up to 12 as part of a whole and part of a group; proper, improper and mixed fractions.

skills.title: Improper and mixed fractions
skills.scope: Convert improper fractions to mixed fractions and mixed fractions to improper fractions.

skills.title: Tenths and hundredths (decimals)
skills.scope: Tenths and hundredths; decimal notation; place value of decimals up to hundredths; ordering decimals up to hundredths.

skills.title: Letters and simple expressions
skills.scope: Represent information using letters; form and simplify simple expressions from real-life situations.

skills.title: Length in centimetres and metres
skills.scope: Measure length in centimetres; relate metres and centimetres; convert metres to centimetres and back.

skills.title: Perimeter of plane figures
skills.scope: Work out the perimeter of plane figures.

skills.title: Operations with metres and centimetres
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide lengths in metres and centimetres.

skills.title: Area of squares and rectangles
skills.scope: Compare areas by direct manipulation; area by counting unit squares; area as rows multiplied by columns.

skills.title: Volume by piling cubes
skills.scope: Pile blocks into cubes and cuboids and count them to find volume.

skills.title: Capacity in litres
skills.scope: Measure capacity in litres, including half and quarter litre; add and subtract capacity in litres.

skills.title: Mass in kilograms
skills.scope: Measure mass in kilograms, including half and quarter kilogram; add and subtract mass in kilograms.

skills.title: Telling time: a.m. and p.m.
skills.scope: Read and tell time in a.m. and p.m. on analogue and digital clocks; estimate the time of day.

skills.title: Time units and durations
skills.scope: Convert hours and minutes, hours and days, days and weeks; record and work out time durations; add and subtract units of time.

skills.title: Shillings and cents
skills.scope: Convert shillings into cents and cents into shillings.

skills.title: Shopping lists and total cost
skills.scope: Prepare a shopping list of three items; work out the total cost (not more than ten thousand shillings).

skills.title: Turns and direction
skills.scope: Clockwise and anti-clockwise turns; quarter, half and full turns.

skills.title: Angles around us
skills.scope: Identify angles at a point where two lines meet and in objects; relate turns to angles.

skills.title: Plane figures
skills.scope: Identify and draw rectangles, squares, triangles, circles and ovals.

skills.title: Lines of symmetry and patterns
skills.scope: Identify lines of symmetry; make patterns using squares, rectangles and triangles.

skills.title: Properties of squares, rectangles and triangles
skills.scope: Identify properties of squares, rectangles and triangles.

skills.title: Collect, record and read data in tables
skills.scope: Collect data of at most 10 items; draw a table, record the data and interpret raw data from the table.
